evidence.quote: Congress appointed on June 10 a committee of five to draft a statement of independence for the colonies.
The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776.

explanations.text: A drafting committee was appointed in June, and the resulting Declaration was adopted on July 4 after revision.

evidence.quote: the approved Declaration was printed on July 5th
These printed copies, bearing only the names of John Hancock, President, and Charles Thomson, secretary,

explanations.text: Printing on July 5 produced copies for state assemblies, conventions, and Continental troops.

evidence.quote: On July 19th, Congress ordered that the Declaration be engrossed on parchment
It was engrossed on parchment and on August 2, 1776, delegates began signing it.

explanations.text: The order to engross the Declaration created the formal parchment copy that delegates began signing in August.
